musicChange.description: Notable changes: key signature, tempo shift, instrumentation changes, dynamic shifts

mood.description: overall emotional tone combining music and narrative

audioEvidence.description: Verifiable sonic proof from this segment (e.g., 'Heavy kick drum starts at 4.2s', 'Reverb-heavy female vocal enters', 'High-pass filter sweep').

transientImpact.description: The physical nature of the audio onset at the start of this segment.

description.description: Detailed description of scene's narrative elements

audioSync.description: how visuals sync with audio (Lip Sync, Mood Sync, Beat Sync)

characterReferenceIds.description: Flattened list of character reference IDs present in scene (not uuid). Example: 'char_hero, char_villain'

locationReferenceId.description: Reference ID where scene takes place (not uuid). Example: 'loc_beach, loc_warehouse'

items.description: Composition of all department specs + audio timing + generation outputs
